title: fix(i18n): system-metadata translation audit — locale fallback, app/dashboard localization, coverage gaps
body:
## Summary

Audit and fix of system-object metadata + server-side translations. Switching the UI language left many surfaces in English ("切换语言之后很多都不生效"), many strings were missing, and some non-English bundles contained English placeholder text ("假的翻译"). Three root causes are addressed.

### 1. Locale fallback (server) — the keystone fix
The metadata translation resolver (`@objectstack/spec` `i18n-resolver`) only did **exact** locale matching, so a request for `zh` (base language, no region) fell back to English instead of hitting the registered `zh-CN` bundle. `pickData` now resolves the requested locale against the locales actually present in the bundle (exact → case-insensitive → base-language → variant), mirroring `resolveLocale` in `@objectstack/core`. This benefits **every** resolver (objects, views, actions, settings, metadata-forms) — the single highest-leverage fix for "switching language doesn't take effect".

### 2. App & dashboard localization (server)
App labels, sidebar/navigation group labels, and dashboard titles/widgets were **never localized** at the REST `/meta` boundary even though the translation data existed. Added `translateApp` / `translateDashboard` resolvers and wired `app`/`dashboard` into the REST translation path (`TRANSLATABLE_META_TYPES`).

### 3. Coverage & quality (data)
- Added translations for the previously **untranslated** platform objects `sys_share_link`, `sys_view_definition`, `sys_metadata_audit` across en/zh-CN/ja-JP/es-ES (label, fields, help, picklist options, views) — they were absent from every bundle.
- Registered those three objects in the i18n-extract config so future `os i18n extract` runs keep them (root cause: they were never in the extraction set).
- Replaced English placeholder strings left in the zh-CN/ja-JP/es-ES object and metadata-form bundles — notably action `confirmText` / `successMessage` confirmation prompts and the new objects' picklist option labels.
- Added the missing `es-ES` built-in Settings bundle in `@objectstack/service-settings` (loaded automatically by the settings plugin; verified structurally identical to `en`).

Remaining identical leaves across locales are intentional exceptions (acronyms / loanwords / format hints: `URL`, `Token`, `Webhook`, `API`, `snake_case`, `GET / POST / …`, and Spanish-identical words like `Actor`/`Error`/`Global`).

## Tests
- New resolver tests: BCP-47 locale fallback (`zh`→`zh-CN`, case-insensitive, variant), `translateApp` (nested navigation), `translateDashboard`.
- `@objectstack/spec` 6616 passing · `@objectstack/rest` 78 · `@objectstack/platform-objects` 78 · `@objectstack/service-settings` 78.
- Full monorepo build green (63/63 packages).

## Notes
- The client already sends `Accept-Language` on every request (#1319), so the base-language fallback fix completes that path end-to-end.
- A changeset is included (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/service-settings` — patch).

## ⚠️ Known unrelated CI failure (not introduced by this PR)
`Test Core` fails on `packages/objectql/src/metadata-validation-sweep.test.ts` — the `workflow` sweep fixture (`sweep_wf`) still uses the **old** workflow shape (`triggerType`/`criteria`/`objectName`) and fails the new state-machine workflow schema (`id`/`initial`/`states`) introduced in #1398 / #1403. The fixture is **byte-identical between `main` (`fa64f4b`) and this branch** — this PR does not touch `packages/objectql`. It surfaces here only because `Test Core` runs when a PR touches a "core" package (this one touches `spec`), whereas translation/UI-only PRs skip it. To be fixed separately in a workflow-focused change. (The `driver-mongodb` red check is an environment-only blocked binary download.)
